subject.title: Claude card: allow model-scoped weekly rows to sit above Daily Routines (or make row order configurable)

question: Should the Claude card adopt a fixed priority for model-scoped weekly limits, or should optional Claude quota rows gain a persisted visibility/order control that covers both this request and the Daily Routines visibility request?
rationale: Both alternatives are viable, but the choice sets the ongoing UI and configuration contract; the related request is already awaiting maintainer product direction.

options.title: Adopt the fixed reorder
options.body: Place model-scoped weekly rows before Daily Routines and keep the card free of new settings.

options.title: Design an optional-row preference
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped, documented row visibility/order preference that resolves both requests together.

options.title: Keep the existing order
options.body: Retain the current fixed presentation if Daily Routines should remain prioritized for all Claude users.

recommendation.title: Adopt the fixed reorder
recommendation.body: Place model-scoped weekly rows before Daily Routines and keep the card free of new settings.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent main history places this person closest to current Claude behavior and the product decision affects the app-wide settings contract.
